item.title: Version 0.9.9
item.description: Enable Sparkle automatic updates — the app will now check for, download, and install updates automatically on launch and periodically.

item.title: Version 0.9.8
item.description:
Bug-fix release covering resource leaks and concurrency fixes across macOS and shared KMP core:
- fix(macos): guard against leaked SCStream on rapid start/stop - fix(shared): add @Volatile to GeminiClient cross-thread state fields - fix(shared): stop audio capture and Gemini on fatal errors

item.title: Version 0.9.5
item.description:
Bug-fix release covering Android capture-lifecycle issues:
Android: - File-transcription decode failures no longer wedge the foreground service — the catch block now tears down the coordinator, notification, and service (was stuck until force-stop). - AudioRecord + MediaProjection are now released immediately on a fatal capture-loop read error, instead of leaking until a manual stop. For MediaProjection this also avoids holding the screen-capture grant and the Android 14 foreground-service-type coupling violation.

item.title: Version 0.9.3
item.description:
Bug-fix release covering two macOS issues:
macOS: - OSD sometimes centered on the wrong display — NSScreen.main tracks the focused app's screen rather than the OSD's, so the overlay could land on whichever display another app's key window was on. Now anchors to the OSD's own screen (falling back to the primary display) and re-centers after display-layout changes. - Bilingual original line leaked through when the setting was off — the server can emit input transcription frames even when not requested, so the source-language line kept showing after toggling Bilingual off. The user's setting is now the authoritative guard.

item.title: Version 0.9.2
item.description:
Bug-fix release covering eight issues across macOS, Android, and the shared KMP core.
Shared (both platforms): - Audio buffer compaction is now O(n) amortized instead of O(n²) per chunk — fixes a steady CPU spike at 10 Hz on Android
macOS: - GeminiClient state mutations from the WebSocket receive callback are now confined to the main queue (was racing start/stop/openConnection) - Transient send failures no longer fire user-visible error notifications (the receive loop is authoritative for connection death) - MicrophoneCapture cleans up its tap on every start error path - HistoryStore now logs write failures (was silently swallowing them) - AppCoordinator's 5 s ready-not-received fallback runs on the main queue
Android: - MediaProjection is now stopped on capture stop (was leaking the screen-capture grant; on Android 14+ this also violated the foreground-service-type coupling rule) - WindowManager exceptions in the overlay are now logged instead of swallowed

item.title: Version 0.9.1
item.description:
Bug fixes for the 0.9.0 OSD length-cap work.
macOS: - Drag clamp no longer fires mid-drag (was using a nonexistent notification; now uses a leftMouseUp monitor) - Line-count math correct (was underestimating line height, causing premature head-truncation) - Font-size changes no longer leave stale overflow or ellipsization - Resize clamps the frame to the screen so large fonts can't push the OSD off the top
Android: - Line budget now accounts for system font-scale (Accessibility → Font size) - Defensive geometry recompute on text update catches display changes that skip onConfigurationChanged (external-display attach in background, foldable unfold)

item.title: Version 0.9.0
item.description: OSD length cap on both platforms: long subtitle lines now wrap to up to 4 lines and head-truncate (drop leading characters with a leading …) so the most recent words stay visible. Max width is screen-relative with a 1200pt ceiling, and the line budget shrinks dynamically at large font sizes so the OSD never overflows the top of the screen. On macOS the bilingual original field now hides when out of vertical room, and dragging the OSD snaps it back on-screen on release.

item.title: Version 0.8.0
item.description: Per-app audio capture: restrict subtitles to a single application (e.g. Chrome, Spotify) via Audio Source → Single App. Other apps' audio is filtered out at the ScreenCaptureKit layer, so you can translate a YouTube video without picking up notification sounds or music from another app. Selection persists by bundle ID and falls back to whole-system capture if the chosen app isn't running.

item.title: Version 0.7.0
item.description: Sparkle 2 in-app auto-update. The app now checks for updates at launch and on demand via the new "Check for Updates…" menu item. Future releases ship through the appcast feed at appcast.xml.
